body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 5c703f642f93f2fec9762a3c031020456908845a -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- `pass_budget` (face.rs) refuses a non-finite/non-positive step, more than 100 000 passes, or a step that cannot advance the coordinate (`span + step == span`), by name, before any allocation. `band` and `cut_levels` return `Result` and every caller propagates with `?`; no unwrap/expect/panic added.
- Pinning tests cover 1e-9 and 1e-300 stepover, staged Face and Contour stepdown, and a normal 0.05 mm step still generating.
- Decision file in `docs/decisions/`, no CHANGELOG/snapshot/dependency/build.rs/.github changes, provenance on the new test, body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #691`.

**Local results (trial-merged with upstream/main, clean merge)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-motion` all suites (incl. `tiny_step` 3/3) | pass |
| `camcraft-app --lib` | 103 pass |
| app `face_holes`, `mill2d_b`, `mill2d_c`, `golden_cl`, `roughing2d`, `refusal_location` | pass |
| clippy `-p camcraft-motion --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |
| other app test binaries | not built: `crates/app/tests/lathe_thread_travel.rs` fails to compile on main (E0063, tracked as #686, not this PR) |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- As the body says, offset-ring pockets and 3D stepovers keep their own loops and are not covered.
- `pass_budget` sits in face.rs and is used from levels.rs; a shared home could come with a later split.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
